title: Count the Number of Vowel Strings in Range
summary: Given an array of strings and two indices, count how many strings within the specified range start and end with a vowel.
statement: Given an array of strings and two indices, count how many strings within the specified range start and end with a vowel.
constraints: A word qualifies when both its first and last lowercase characters are vowels.
Inspect the inclusive index interval from left through right.
Return the number of qualifying words.
hints: Store the five vowels in a set.
Slice or scan the inclusive range only.
For each word, test both boundary characters and add the resulting Boolean.
Every word is independently counted exactly when both defining conditions hold.
editorial: Every word is independently counted exactly when both defining conditions hold.

tests.explanation: Words are and u start and end with vowels, so the answer is two.
Only aeo and ooo have vowels at both boundaries.
